articles.title: Benefits Brokers Must Adopt New Strategies to Manage Escalating Employer Health Care Costs
articles.summary: Rising employer healthcare costs are forcing benefits brokers to rethink traditional advisory models and adopt innovative cost-containment strategies. This shift matters because self-funded employers increasingly demand proactive solutions to combat surging pharmacy and medical expenses without compromising employee care. For RxBenefits and its partners, this environment creates a prime opportunity to position transparent pharmacy benefit management alternatives as an essential component of the modern broker playbook.
articles.source_line: Source: Insurance Business; Wed, 09 Sep 2026 01:28:45 GMT

articles.title: Model Optimal Care Introduces AI Platform Designed Specifically for Self-Funded Health Plans
articles.summary: Model Optimal Care has launched MOC Fiduciary Intelligence, a new artificial intelligence platform built from the ground up to support self-funded employers. This tool addresses the growing need for enhanced oversight and cost management within employer-sponsored healthcare plans by leveraging AI to streamline fiduciary responsibilities. For organizations managing self-funded benefits, this technology offers a new way to navigate complex plan data, potentially improving cost containment and compliance.
articles.source_line: Source: EIN News; Tue, 08 Sep 2026 11:30:00 GMT
